rollbackDeadline.rule: Synthetic: 14 days after the switch, or sooner if a later transfer depends on this context.

allowedDowntime.note: Synthetic: writes to the frozen set get 409 context_frozen; reads stay open.

recoveryTimeObjective.scale: Synthetic: the per-account scale floor (spec 2020-2028) with 10 benchmark accounts.

compatibility.forward: Synthetic: the new release reads legacy rows through the adapter until the switch.
compatibility.reverse: Synthetic: the previous release reads canonical rows replayed into legacy form by the compensation journal.
compatibility.versionMarker: Synthetic: startup refuses a schema or client version the marker does not list.

finalWriteFreezeBoundary.fence: Synthetic: the change-journal sequence noted before the snapshot; entries past it are applied as the final delta.

journal.location: Synthetic: the run journal and compensation journal of the migration framework.

externalEffects.publicShares: Synthetic: no share changes target; a rollback leaves capabilities on their revisions.
externalEffects.exports: Synthetic: exports made after the switch stay valid and are listed in the receipt.
externalEffects.emails: Synthetic: none sent by this transfer.

partialDeployDetection.mechanism: Synthetic: the version marker and a client version header; a mismatched replica refuses writes.

readModels.note: Synthetic: projectors rebuild from the restored authority, and sections read stale until they catch up.

decisionOwner.role: Synthetic: the operator running the transfer

backupConsistency.method: Synthetic: a snapshot taken while the context is frozen, checked against per-store counts and checksums.
backupConsistency.evidence: Synthetic: a rehearsal receipt at the current fingerprint.
